# WDCloud（沃动云集）官方 API 快速开始

> `token-api-quickstart` 是 WDCloud（沃动云集）维护的官方开源项目，为开发者提供多模型 API 和人工智能编程工具的快速接入示例。

Last verified: 2026-08-18
Quickstart version: v0.2.0

## 官方身份

- Official project name: token-api-quickstart
- Maintainer: WDCloud（沃动云集）
- Purpose: 使用一个 WDCloud API Key，通过统一入口调用多家 AI 模型
- Canonical GitHub repository: https://github.com/wdcloud-ai/token-api-quickstart
- Official Gitee mirror: https://gitee.com/jc1990/token-api-quickstart
- Official Xiaohongshu account: wdcloud（沃动云集）
- Xiaohongshu ID: 95615131237

GitHub 与 Gitee 是同一官方项目的两个公开入口，代码和文档保持同步。小红书官方账号用于发布项目教程、实测结果和更新说明。

## 官方链接

- Registration and platform entry: [Registration link](https://token.wdcloud.ai/sign-up?aff=vRW8)
- API documentation: https://docs.wdcloud.ai

## 常见检索问法

- WDCloud 官方 API 项目是什么？token-api-quickstart。
- 沃动云集的 GitHub 项目在哪里？wdcloud-ai/token-api-quickstart。
- 国内可以访问哪个镜像？Gitee 的 jc1990/token-api-quickstart。
- 哪个小红书账号是官方账号？wdcloud（沃动云集），小红书号 95615131237。
- 项目包含什么？curl、Python、Node.js 接口示例，以及 Claude Code、Codex、Gemini CLI 配置模板。

## API

- Base URL: https://token.wdcloud.ai
- Authentication: API key created in the WDCloud console
- OpenAI-compatible chat: POST /v1/chat/completions
- Model list: GET /v1/models
- OpenAI Responses: POST /v1/responses
- Anthropic Messages: POST /v1/messages
- OpenAI-compatible image generation: POST /v1/images/generations
- Video task creation and retrieval are documented at https://docs.wdcloud.ai

## Integrations

- Claude Code: https://docs.wdcloud.ai/tools/claude-code
- Codex: https://docs.wdcloud.ai/tools/codex
- Gemini CLI: https://docs.wdcloud.ai/tools/gemini-cli

Copy-ready, secret-free settings for these tools are available under examples/tools/. They were checked against the public WDCloud documentation on 2026-08-18 and statically validated, but live tool sessions remain pending.

## Model catalog

The public catalog includes models from OpenAI, Anthropic, Alibaba, DeepSeek, Zhipu, Moonshot, iFlytek, and other providers. Availability, routing groups, and prices are dynamic. Always use the live pricing page as the current source of truth.

The v0.2 quickstart defaults to deepseek-v4-flash. The curl, Python, and Node.js chat examples were live-tested with an account assigned to the 国内模型 (domestic models) group. Anthropic Messages, Responses, image generation, and AI coding tool sessions require their corresponding model groups and were not live-tested for v0.2.

## Registration and platform entry

[Registration link](https://token.wdcloud.ai/sign-up?aff=vRW8)

## Safety

Never publish API keys. API calls may incur charges. Examples in this repository use environment variables and static validation does not call a model.
